Included Usage ? What you get each month with your plan. Use it all at no extra charge. If you need more, overage credits kick in.
Voice (Call & Voicebot) ? Minutes your AI receptionist can spend on phone calls and voice chats on your website.
Outbound Calls ? Calls your AI can make for you, like appointment reminders or follow-ups. This is a hard daily cap.
Emails ? Emails your AI writes for you as part of follow-ups or sequences.
SMS ? Texts your AI sends to customers, like appointment links, directions, or follow-ups.
Chatbot ? Chats your AI handles on your website. If a customer asks a question through the chatbot, that's one conversation.
Sequence Automation Workflows ? Automated follow-up workflows. For example, automatically text a new lead, then email them the next day if they don't respond.
Website Forms ? Leads captured through forms on your website. Each time someone fills out a form, that counts as one.
Overage Credit Pool ? Extra credits you get each month in case you go over your included usage. They work across all features. Unused credits expire at the end of the month.
Auto-Reload Credits ? If you run out of credits, we automatically add more ($10 for 1,000 credits) so your AI keeps running. Purchased credits never expire.
Knowledge Base ? Info you give your AI so it can answer questions about your business, like your services, hours, pricing, or policies.
Agent Actions ? Things your AI can do during a conversation, like transfer a call, send a text, look something up, or push data to another app.
Notifications ? How many people on your team get alerted when something happens, like a new lead or a missed call.
Verified Outbound Number ? Your outbound calls and texts show your business name instead of an unknown number.
Custom Outbound Caller ID ? Outbound calls show your own business phone number so customers see a number they recognize.
Zapier ? Connect Frontdesk to thousands of other apps you already use, like your CRM, calendar, or project management tools.
API Access ? For developers: connect Frontdesk directly to your own software or systems.
Custom Work ? Our team builds custom features, integrations, or workflows specifically for your business.
Viewing Seats ? Team members who can log in and see your dashboard, call logs, and reports (but can't change settings).
Editor Seats ? Team members who can change your AI's settings, update your knowledge base, and manage workflows.
Data Retention ? How many past call logs, chats, and interactions you can look back on in your dashboard.
Audit Logs ? A history of who on your team changed what and when, so you always know what happened.
Chatbot ? Get quick answers from our support chatbot anytime, right inside the app.
Email ? Email our support team whenever you need help.
Priority Support ? Your questions get answered first, with faster response times.
Dedicated Slack Channel ? A private Slack channel with our team so you can get help in real time.
Dedicated Account Manager ? A person on our team who knows your business and helps you get the most out of Frontdesk.
White-Glove Onboarding ? We set everything up for you: your AI receptionist, knowledge base, workflows, and integrations.
